rows.en: (...Okay, so P.E.'s over, huh...)

\p-san,
you were really giving it your all.

You're pretty athletic too, Luca.
Hard to believe you're a year younger than me.
I can't afford to fall behind, after all...
Oh, that's the spirit.

Shall we head back and change?
I'm all sticky with sweat.

(...I'd better make sure I don't fall asleep
in the next class.)

You're pretty athletic too, Luca-kun.
Hard to believe you're a year younger than me.
Yeah, me too!
rows.notes: Female player answering Luca's 'I'm all sticky with sweat, let's go change'.

rows.en:
(...All this wandering around made me hungry...
Maybe I'll grab something to eat.)

\p-san!
It's rare to run into you in a place like this.
Hey, Luca. Out shopping?

Yes, I came to buy a new-model stabilizer
for Samson.
A new model... You never change, do you...

Samson's my partner, after all.
I don't want to cut any corners.
rows.notes: Japanese 'boku no aibou desu kara ne' with Samson (Luca's EX-Gear) as the dropped subject; named it rather than pick a pronoun.

rows.en:
Well then, I have maintenance to do on Samson,
so if you'll excuse me.
(Where does Luca's passion even come from...?)

(...I'm hungry...
Maybe I'll grab something to eat.)
Oh, Luca-kun. Out shopping?
A new model... You never change, huh...
(Where does Luca-kun's passion even come from...?)
(I'd better warm up properly before swimming...)

\p-san, if you're on your own,
would you like to warm up together?
Sure, let's do it.
I-I don't know where to look...
rows.notes: The girls around them are in swimsuits.

rows.en: Y-Yeah, tell me about it...

They're all cute, huh...
So, Luca, for you it's gotta be......
rows.notes: Trails off before naming Nanase, as the Japanese.

rows.en: N-Nanase-san has nothing to do with it, okay?

I didn't even say anything...
You're so easy to read.

\p-san, stretch your legs out.
It'd be awful if you got a cramp in the water!
O-Okay, I get it, so stop pushing so hard!!
rows.notes: Shown as the male player's line (the Luca-plate occurrences are not displayed, fn 37); Luca is pushing the player into the stretch.

rows.en: (It's a class, but maybe I'll just enjoy the swim.)
Yeah, okay!
What, so looking at me doesn't bother you?
rows.notes: Female player teasing Luca: literally 'mine doesn't bother you?' (her swimsuit figure) after he says he does not know where to look.

rows.en: ...Th-That's not what I meant...

But they're all cute, huh.
Soooo~ Luca-kun, for you it's gotta be~

I didn't even say anything...
You're so easy to read.
O-Okay, I get it, so stop pushing so hard!!
(Next class is math, huh...)

Let's see, there was homework, right...
...Huh? It's not here!!

\p-san,
is something wrong? You were shouting.
...I forgot my math homework.

I see, that's rough.
Well then, I'll just go get a drink of water...

Hey, Luca!
If it's okay, let me see your textbook.
I want to get it done now while I can.

...It's so full of my notes that
you won't be able to read it, you know?
That's totally fine!

Whoa, it really is covered in writing...
What does all this even say...?

All sorts of things. I jot down
whatever ideas come to me.
(Geniuses really are something else~)
(Next class is math...)

Let's see, there was homework, wasn't there...
...Huh? It's not here!!
...I forgot my math homework...

Hey, Luca-kun!
If it's okay, let me see your textbook.
I want to get it done now while I can...
That's totally fine.

Wow, it really is covered in writing...
What does all this even say...?

All sorts of things. I jot down
whatever ideas come to me.
(Geniuses really are on another level~)
What are you going for, Luca-kun?
rows.notes: Displayed only in the female scene (player line); the male-scene occurrence is not displayed (fn 37).

rows.en: (Class is finally over... I'm starving...)

\p-san,
shall we go get lunch?

Sure. Is it okay if we buy something
at the school store first?
Yes, that's what I was planning to do too.
What are you going for, Luca?

I haven't decided yet.
I can eat just about anything.
Even a rainbow carrot bun?
rows.notes: nanairo ninjin pan: 'rainbow carrots' per terms.json + bun.

rows.en: Well, that might be a bit much...
Okay, let's hurry up and buy something!

(Please let them have something other than
rainbow carrot buns~)

Sure. Is it okay if we buy something
at the school store first?

uncertain: c17831/c17858: speaker plates differ between occurrences; only fn 0 occurrences are displayed, so treated as player lines.
c17865/c17868: 'rainbow carrot bun' built from the glossary 'rainbow carrots'; the bun itself is not in the glossary.
